name: Western Starr
role: Justice of the peace at Dickinson
bio: Western Starr was a justice of the peace at Dickinson who visited Medora on legal business and, in 1885-86, fined Medora men brought before him for firing weapons and for assault. At a Fourth of July celebration in 1886 he read the Declaration of Independence.
